_comment: Copy this file's real-credential version to config.json (already this filename — fill in and NEVER commit real tokens; add config.json to .gitignore for this workflow).

instagram._help: Facebook Developers → Your App → Instagram Graph API. Requires instagram_basic + instagram_manage_insights scopes on a Business/Creator account linked to a Facebook Page. Read-only scopes only — never request publish permissions for this connector.

linkedin._help: LinkedIn Developer Portal → Marketing API access (requires application/approval). Request r_organization_social read scope only.
